hero.title: Energy Optimized
hero.description: Designing high-efficiency heat exchangers, advanced cooling systems, and specialized thermal management configurations to maximize energy utilization and system reliability.

capabilities.title: Conduction & Convection Modeling
capabilities.description: Analyzing complex heat transfer interfaces, designing optimized fin geometries, and calculating fluid velocity profiles for forced and natural convection cooling.

capabilities.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
capabilities.description: Simulating high-fidelity conjugate heat transfer (CHT) models, multiphase fluid interactions, and boundary layer behaviors to eliminate thermal hot spots.

capabilities.title: HVAC & Power Plant Systems
capabilities.description: Optimizing industrial steam cycles, gas turbine dynamics, refrigeration systems, and large-scale psychrometric processes for maximum thermodynamic efficiency.

projects.title: Electric Induction Boiler System
projects.description: This project focuses on the design and implementation of a 50 kg/hr electric induction boiler system to replace the existing LDO-fired boiler at Attach Industries.
